metadata.host_selection_rule: storage-only: direct child contract with most references; lexical canonical-id tie-break

views: non-secret key/fingerprint metadata where policy permits
semantics.secret_rule: Private keys/session secrets are never displayed.
semantics.identity_rule: UI distinguishes peer semantic identity from transient transport/session ids.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing or inspecting a secure session does not grant data/operation authority.
semantics.action_rule: Reconnect/close/reload actions invoke separate explicit canonical operations.
semantics.redaction_rule: Sensitive peer/security metadata is redacted according to policy.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed lifecycle events retain exact peer/service/session refs where non-secret.

invariants.rule: Transport session, cryptographic material, signaling metadata and semantic identity remain separate; secure transport never implies application authorization.

hard_gates.condition: session id shown as peer semantic identity
monitor directly mutates transport without explicit operation
security failure hidden from monitor trace
